items.label: Eoptolink half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
items.signal_prefix: 2026 half-year report: the company released the NX200/300 series OCS

set.signal: 2026 half-year report: the company released the NX200/300 series OCS products based on its self-developed 3D MEMS technology. H1 2026 R&D spend RMB 439,990,921.22 (up 31.85%), 2.1% of revenue, all expensed.

items.reason: Depth: the 1.6T DR4, silicon-photonics 6.4T NPO and 12.8T XPO launches (March 2026) were already on the node from the 2025 annual report (04-24-2026) entry; keep only what the half-year report adds (NX200/300 OCS, H1 R&D).
items.evidence: 先后推出基于 400G PAM4 的新一代 1.6T DR4 OSFP 光模块、基于硅光技术的 6.4T NPO 模块和行业首款 12.8T XPO 光模块,并发布基于自研 3D MEMS 技术的 NX200/300 系列 OCS 产品
